name: Code review
title: Code review: {{repo}} PR {{number}} ({{short_title}})
description:
Code review of {{repo}} PR #{{number}} ({{ticket}}, "{{title}}", {{files}} files, +{{added}} -{{removed}}, {{draft}}): {{pr}}

How to review (use {{review_skill}}):
If that skill is not available in this session, say so and ask me before using a different one.
1. Read the PR diff and the ticket. Read the repo on fresh origin/main (fetch, then git show / git grep), inside the existing repo folder and without making any copy.
2. Bugs and regressions: look for new bugs or issues, and for behavior that changes for existing callers.
3. Scope: check the PR does only what the ticket asks. List anything extra, and anything the ticket asks for that is missing.
4. Cross-service impact: check whether the change affects other services (callers, events, shared contracts or data). Use the code and the logs as evidence.
5. Risk analysis: give a risk level with a level of confidence, and say which parts rest on code evidence and which on log evidence.
6. Recommendation: end with a clear verdict on whether to approve or not, with the reasons.
7. Comments: write every review comment needed, including inline ones (file and line), in the Findings tab. Do not post anything to GitHub unless I ask.
